name: paylark
description: Paylark payments for Gemini CLI: the Paylark MCP server plus skills for adding checkout, subscriptions, license keys and signed webhooks to your app.

settings.name: Paylark API base URL
settings.description: Where your Paylark server runs, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://app.example.com or http://localhost:8080.

settings.name: Paylark API key
settings.description: Secret key from Dashboard > Developers > API keys. Use a test key (sk_test_...); live keys only get read-only tools.
